# Dental Price Guide

> Independent guide to what dental procedures cost in the United States. Every price is a national figure taken from a named, published source (Delta Dental out-of-network claims data 2021–2025; Synchrony/CareCredit Average Procedural Cost Study 2023–2024; GoodRx; Pearl dental cost data based on the ADA fee survey). Pages are medically reviewed by Dr. Faisal Irshad, MBBS. Prices last checked October 2026.

## About
- [Methodology: where our prices come from](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/methodology/)
- [About and medical review](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/about/)

## Oral Surgery
- [Gum Graft Cost in 2026: Surgery Prices, Insurance and Ways to Pay Less](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/gum-graft-cost/): A gum graft costs $2,742 on average, with a range of $2,120 to $4,982 (CareCredit). See state prices, graft types, insurance and how to pay less.
- [Tooth Extraction Cost in 2026: Simple and Surgical Prices, Insurance and Aftercare](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/tooth-extraction-cost/): Tooth extraction cost: $150 to $310 per simple extraction and $260 to $460 per surgical extraction out-of-network (Delta Dental). Insurance and aftercare.
- [Wisdom Teeth Removal Cost: What You'll Pay With and Without Insurance](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/wisdom-teeth-removal-cost/): Wisdom teeth removal cost runs from $720 for four erupted teeth to $3,120 or more for surgical removal with sedation. See prices, insurance and savings.
- [Normal Socket After Tooth Extraction: What Healing Looks Like Day by Day](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/tooth-extraction-healing-stages/): What a normal socket after tooth extraction looks like: dark clot on day 1, white granulation tissue by days 2–3, gum closure in weeks. Plus warning signs.
- [What to Eat After Tooth Extraction: Soft Foods, Timing and When Solids Return](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-to-eat-after-tooth-extraction/): What to eat after tooth extraction: cool liquids and soft foods first, then a slow return to solids over about a week. Plus foods to avoid and costs.
- [Smoking After Tooth Extraction: How Long to Wait, Plus Straws, Coffee and Alcohol](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/smoking-after-tooth-extraction/): How long to wait before smoking after a tooth extraction, and when straws, coffee and alcohol are safe. Why smoking raises dry socket risk and how to cope.
- [What to Eat After Wisdom Teeth Removal: Soft Foods and a Day-by-Day Timeline](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-to-eat-after-wisdom-teeth-removal/): What to eat after wisdom teeth removal, day by day: soft foods for week one and when rice, pizza, chips, spicy food and burgers are usually safe again.
- [Wisdom Teeth Recovery Timeline: What to Expect Day by Day](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/wisdom-teeth-recovery-timeline/): Wisdom teeth recovery usually takes 3 to 7 days for daily life and several weeks for the sockets. See the day-by-day timeline, brushing and sleep tips.
- [Wisdom Teeth Pain: What It Feels Like, What Helps and When to See a Dentist](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/wisdom-teeth-pain/): Wisdom teeth pain explained: common symptoms, jaw, ear and headache pain, home relief that helps, warning signs of infection, and what removal costs.
- [When Do Wisdom Teeth Come In? Typical Age, First Signs and What Happens Next](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/when-do-wisdom-teeth-come-in/): When do wisdom teeth come in? Usually between ages 17 and 25. Learn the first signs, where they grow, when they stop growing and what removal costs.
- [Impacted Wisdom Teeth: Symptoms, When Removal Is Needed and What It Costs](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/impacted-wisdom-teeth/): Impacted wisdom teeth explained: types, symptoms, when removal is advised, recovery, and costs from $835 per impacted tooth in CareCredit's survey.
- [Does Everyone Have Wisdom Teeth? Why We Have Them, How Many and Where They Grow](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/why-do-we-have-wisdom-teeth/): Does everyone have wisdom teeth? No. Most adults develop up to four, some have fewer or none. Learn why they exist, where they grow and removal costs.
- [How Long After Wisdom Teeth Removal Can I Use a Straw, Drink Coffee, Soda or Alcohol?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/drinking-after-wisdom-teeth-removal/): How long after wisdom teeth removal can I use a straw? Most surgeons say about a week. See timelines for coffee, soda, alcohol and smoking, plus red flags.
- [How Long Does Wisdom Teeth Removal Take? Surgery Time, Prep and Recovery](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/how-long-does-wisdom-teeth-removal-take/): How long wisdom teeth removal takes: the surgery itself usually runs under an hour, plus check-in and recovery time. How to prepare and what each step involves.
- [Dry Socket After Wisdom Teeth Removal: Signs, Prevention and Treatment](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dry-socket-after-wisdom-teeth/): Dry socket after wisdom teeth removal causes worsening pain a few days after surgery. How to spot it, how to prevent it and how dentists treat it.
- [Do You Have to Get Wisdom Teeth Removed? Benefits of Keeping Them and When Removal Is Needed](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/do-you-have-to-get-wisdom-teeth-removed/): Not everyone needs wisdom teeth removed. When keeping them is fine, why people get them removed, what happens if you don't, and what removal costs.

## Implants & Tooth Replacement
- [Dental Bridge Cost: What a Tooth Bridge Costs With and Without Insurance](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-bridge-cost/): Dental bridge cost averages $1,569 for a Maryland bridge and about $3,600 for a three-unit bridge, with more for some types. See insurance and savings.
- [Dental Implant Cost in 2026: What One Tooth, Several Teeth and a Full Arch Really Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-implant-cost/): Dental implant cost for one tooth runs $2,800 to $5,600 without dental benefits, per Delta Dental. See what drives the price and how to pay less.
- [Dentures Cost in 2026: What Full, Partial and Implant Dentures Really Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dentures-cost/): Dentures cost $1,115 to $2,425 for a full lower and $1,220 to $2,540 for a full upper out-of-network (Delta Dental). Prices by type, insurance and savings.
- [What Is a Dental Bridge? How Tooth Bridges Work, the Main Types, Lifespan and Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-is-a-dental-bridge/): A dental bridge fills the gap from a missing tooth with a false tooth anchored to nearby teeth. See bridge types, the procedure, lifespan and costs.
- [Cost of Full Mouth Dental Implants: All-on-4, Per-Tooth Implants and Insurance](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/full-mouth-dental-implants-cost/): Cost of full mouth dental implants: All-on-4 averages $15,176 per arch, so two arches cost roughly double. See extra costs, insurance and ways to save.
- [Types of Dental Implants: Endosteal, Mini, Zygomatic, All-on-4 and More](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/types-of-dental-implants/): Types of dental implants explained: endosteal, mini, zygomatic, subperiosteal and All-on-4, plus screwless implants, the process and average US costs.
- [What Insurance Covers Dental Implants, and What You Will Still Pay](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-implants-cost-with-insurance/): Does dental insurance cover implants? Many plans pay 50% as major work up to the annual maximum. Implant costs of $2,800 to $5,600 per tooth and how to plan.
- [399 Dental Implants: What Low-Price Implant Ads Really Include](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/399-dental-implants/): Ads for 399 dollar dental implants rarely cover a finished tooth. What the price usually includes, real implant costs of $2,800 to $5,600, and questions to ask.
- [Do Dental Implants Hurt? Pain, Safety and Signs of a Bad Dental Implant](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/do-dental-implants-hurt/): Do dental implants hurt? Surgery is done under anesthesia, with soreness for a few days. Are implants safe, what can go wrong, and signs of a bad implant.
- [Snap In Dentures Cost: What Implant-Supported Dentures Cost and Why](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/snap-in-dentures-cost/): Snap in dentures (implant-supported full dentures) cost $10,500 to $21,500 without insurance, per GoodRx. See what drives the price and how to pay less.
- [Flexible Dentures Cost in 2026: What a Flexible Partial Costs and Whether It Is Worth It](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/flexible-dentures-cost/): Flexible dentures cost about $1,700 for a nylon partial without insurance, per GoodRx. Compare acrylic and metal partials, insurance and ways to pay less.
- [Before and After Partial Dentures: What Changes and How Much Partials Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/partial-dentures-cost/): Partial dentures before and after: how your smile and chewing change, plus out-of-network costs of $1,425 to $2,490 (lower) and $1,435 to $2,785 (upper).
- [Types of Dentures and Cost: Full, Partial, Immediate, Flexible and Implant-Supported](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/types-of-dentures/): Types of dentures and cost compared: basic sets average $452, premium $6,514 (CareCredit); implant-supported dentures run $10,500 to $21,500 (GoodRx).

## Braces & Orthodontics
- [How Much Are Braces? Average Braces Cost by Type, Insurance and Age](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/braces-cost/): How much are braces? Metal braces average $6,343 and comprehensive treatment runs $3,680 to $9,650 nationally. Compare types, insurance and ways to save.
- [Braces Colors: How to Choose the Best Color for Your Braces](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/braces-colors/): Braces colors explained: which shades make teeth look whiter, which to avoid, how often you can change them, and what braces cost on average in the US.
- [Clear Braces Cost in 2026: Ceramic Braces and Clear Aligner Prices Compared](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/clear-braces-cost/): Clear braces cost about $5,834 on average for ceramic braces and $5,108 for clear aligners. See what drives the price, insurance and ways to pay less.
- [How Much Are Braces Without Insurance, and How Much With It?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/braces-cost-insurance/): How much are braces without insurance? Comprehensive braces run $3,680 to $9,650 nationally (Pearl). Costs by type, with insurance and ways to pay less.
- [Power Chain Braces: What Power Chains Do, How They Feel and What They Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/power-chain-braces/): Power chain braces explained: what power chains do, why orthodontists add them, how long you wear them, how they feel, and how they fit into braces costs.
- [What Can You Not Eat With Braces? Foods to Avoid, Foods to Enjoy and Why It Matters](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-can-you-eat-with-braces/): What can you not eat with braces? Skip hard, sticky and chewy foods like popcorn, gum, nuts and caramel. See safe swaps for pizza, chips and candy.
- [Ceramic Braces: How They Work, Pros and Cons, and What They Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/ceramic-braces/): Ceramic braces use tooth-colored brackets that blend in with your teeth. Compare them with metal braces, learn how to avoid stains and see average cost.
- [Lingual Braces: How They Work, What They Cost and Who They Suit](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/lingual-braces/): Lingual braces sit behind your teeth so they are hidden. CareCredit puts the average at $9,221; Delta Dental cites $8,000 to $10,000. Pros, cons and fit.
- [Metal Braces: Cost, How Traditional Braces Work and What to Expect](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/metal-braces/): Traditional metal braces average $6,343 (CareCredit); Delta Dental cites $3,000 to $7,000. How they work, how they compare and what treatment is like.
- [How Long Do Braces Take? Treatment Length, Getting Them On and Off](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/how-long-do-braces-take/): Most people wear braces for one to three years. How long it takes to put braces on and take them off, what speeds treatment up and what slows it down.
- [Rubber Bands for Braces: What They Do, How to Wear Them and Common Problems](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/rubber-bands-for-braces/): What rubber bands do for braces, the common band patterns, how many hours to wear them, how to cope with soreness, and what happens if you skip them.
- [How Do Braces Work? From Their Invention to Fixing an Overbite](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/how-do-braces-work/): How braces work to move teeth through bone, when braces were invented, how to get braces and whether braces can fix an overbite. Plus typical costs.
- [Do Braces Hurt? What Getting Braces Feels Like and How Long Soreness Lasts](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/do-braces-hurt/): Do braces hurt? Getting braces on is not painful, but teeth usually ache for a few days afterward and after adjustments. How long it lasts and how to ease it.
- [When Should Kids Get Braces, and How Much Do Braces Cost for Kids?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/braces-cost-for-kids/): Most kids start braces between about 9 and 14. First orthodontic check by age 7. Braces cost averages: metal $6,343, ceramic $5,834, aligners $5,108.

## Cosmetic Dentistry
- [How Much Is Teeth Bonding? Dental Bonding Cost Per Tooth in 2026](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-bonding-cost/): How much is teeth bonding? Dental bonding costs $300 to $600 per tooth (Healthline), with a $431 national average. See what affects price and how to save.
- [Teeth Whitening Cost: What Professional and At-Home Whitening Really Costs](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/teeth-whitening-cost/): Teeth whitening cost at a dentist runs $40 to $700 per in-office visit, with laser whitening averaging $792. Compare options, insurance and ways to save.
- [Veneers Cost in 2026: Price Per Tooth, Full Sets and How to Pay Less](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/veneers-cost/): Veneers cost $1,180 to $2,185 per porcelain tooth without insurance (Delta Dental). See full-set prices, what drives the cost and ways to pay less.
- [Best At Home Teeth Whitening Kits: How to Choose a Safe Option That Works for You](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/best-at-home-teeth-whitening-kits/): Best at home teeth whitening kits compared by type: strips, trays, pens, LED kits and toothpaste, plus when in-office whitening at $40 to $700 makes sense.
- [Do You Brush Your Teeth After Whitening Strips? Before vs After, Safety and Results](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/whitening-strips-guide/): Do you brush your teeth after whitening strips? Yes, gently, to clear leftover gel. Learn when to brush before, avoiding sensitivity, and if strips work.
- [The Best Teeth Whitening Toothpaste: Ingredients That Work and How to Choose](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/best-whitening-toothpaste/): How to choose the best teeth whitening toothpaste: which ingredients remove stains, what peroxide does, how much whiter to expect, and when to try other options.
- [What Are Veneers? How Dental Veneers Work, Types and What They Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-are-veneers/): What are veneers? Thin shells bonded to the front of teeth. Learn the types, the process, what teeth look like underneath, and what veneers cost per tooth.
- [Veneers Before and After: What Changes, What It Costs and How to Spot Bad Veneers](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/veneers-before-and-after/): Veneers before and after: how teeth are prepared, what results look like, signs of bad veneers, and costs of $1,180 to $2,185 per porcelain tooth.
- [Are Veneers Permanent? How Long Porcelain and Composite Veneers Last](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/how-long-do-veneers-last/): Veneers are a permanent commitment, but the veneers themselves need replacing. Porcelain often lasts 10 to 20 years, composite less. What affects lifespan.
- [Veneers vs Crowns: Key Differences, Cost and How to Choose](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/veneers-vs-crowns/): Veneers vs crowns: a veneer covers the front of a tooth, a crown covers the whole tooth. Which suits you, how much tooth is removed and what each costs.

## Restorative Dentistry
- [Types of Dental Crowns and Cost: What a Crown Really Costs in 2026](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-crown-cost/): Types of dental crowns and cost compared: a permanent crown runs $1,100 to $2,000 out-of-network. See prices by material, insurance and ways to pay less.
- [How Much Does a Filling Cost? Cavity Filling Prices by Material and Insurance in 2026](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/cavity-filling-cost/): How much does a filling cost? Composite fillings cost $145 to $480 on front teeth and $165 to $530 on back teeth without insurance. Compare amalgam and insurance.
- [Root Canal Cost in 2026: What You'll Pay by Tooth, With and Without Insurance](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/root-canal-cost/): Root canal cost runs about $685 to $1,800 per tooth nationally, with molars near $1,500 out-of-network. See prices by tooth, insurance and how to pay less.
- [Tooth Abscess: What Treatment Costs, Your Options and When It Is an Emergency](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/tooth-abscess/): Tooth abscess treatment costs about $1,200 to $1,500 for a root canal or $150 to $310 for a simple extraction. See options, insurance and red flags.
- [What Is a Dental Crown? Types, the Crown Procedure and What Crowns Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-is-a-dental-crown/): What is a dental crown? A tooth-shaped cap cemented over a damaged tooth. Learn the types of crowns, the procedure, how long they last and what they cost.
- [Cavity Filling: What It Is, How Long It Takes and What to Expect](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/cavity-filling/): Cavity filling explained: what happens step by step, how long a filling takes, composite vs amalgam, aftercare, warning signs, and typical US costs.
- [How Long Does a Root Canal Take? Appointment Time, Recovery and Aftercare](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/how-long-does-a-root-canal-take/): How long does a root canal take? Usually one or two visits of about an hour or more each. See recovery time, eating and driving after, and typical costs.
- [Root Canal Pain: Does a Root Canal Hurt, and How Long Does Soreness Last?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/does-a-root-canal-hurt/): Root canal pain is usually mild: the tooth is numbed, and soreness after often fades in a few days. Learn what to expect and how to ease throbbing pain.
- [What Is a Root Canal Procedure? Steps, Recovery and Cost](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/what-is-a-root-canal/): A root canal removes infected pulp from inside a tooth and seals it. What happens step by step, recovery, and cost (about $1,200 for a front tooth).
- [Root Canal Symptoms: How to Know If You Need One (and How to Avoid It)](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/root-canal-symptoms/): Root canal symptoms include lingering sensitivity, pain when biting, swelling and a darkening tooth. When you need one, how to avoid it and what it costs.
- [How Much Is a Root Canal Without Insurance?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/root-canal-cost-without-insurance/): A root canal without insurance costs about $1,200 for a front tooth, $1,300 for a premolar and $1,500 for a molar (Delta Dental), plus the crown. Ways to pay less.
- [Root Canal Before and After: What Your Tooth Looks and Feels Like](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/root-canal-before-and-after/): Root canal before and after: how the tooth looks, feels and functions before treatment, right after, and once the crown is placed. Recovery and cost.
- [How Much Does a Root Canal Cost With Insurance?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/root-canal-cost-with-insurance/): Insurance commonly covers 50%–80% of a root canal after the deductible (Delta Dental). How your share is calculated, crown costs and how to estimate your bill.
- [Tooth Abscess Stages: From Cavity to Swelling, and When to Get Help](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/tooth-abscess-stages/): The stages of a tooth abscess, from enamel decay to pulp infection, abscess and spreading swelling. Symptoms at each stage, warning signs and treatment costs.

## Preventive Care & Insurance
- [Dental Cleaning Cost in 2026: Standard, Deep and Periodontal Cleanings Compared](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-cleaning-cost/): Dental cleaning cost runs $85 to $160 for a standard cleaning without dental benefits, per Delta Dental. Compare deep cleaning, X-ray and exam prices.
- [How Much Does Dental Insurance Cost? Premiums, Coverage and What You Really Pay](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-insurance-cost/): How much does dental insurance cost? Learn what drives premiums, how 100-80-50 coverage and a $1,500 annual maximum work, and when a plan pays off.
- [How Much Is a Dental Cleaning Without Insurance?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/dental-cleaning-cost-without-insurance/): A standard dental cleaning without insurance costs $85 to $160 (Delta Dental). Deep cleaning, exams and X-rays add more. Prices and ways to pay less.
- [How Much Does a Deep Cleaning of Teeth Cost?](https://www.dentalpriceguide.com/deep-cleaning-teeth-cost/): A deep cleaning costs $180 to $295 per quadrant (Delta Dental), and CareCredit reports a $242 average. Full-mouth cost, insurance, and the downsides to know.
